numericSemantics.state: Host supplies snapshots; consumed graph roots compute numerical decisions and next state. Rendering, IO and FP64 compatibility remain host operations.

state.native: FP64 departure assignment (ceil to 90-minute slot), storage, strings and flight labels stay host; every window/ticket/security/landing decision is a graph root.
Continuous ease/hat curves, cycle-time modulo and look targets stay native FP64; beat index and ringing flag are graph roots.

String place lists/companion union, Ym hour table lookup, FP64 slot floor and residue reduction (unbounded clock), hash and string result lookup stay host; opening hours, awake gate, choice count, modulo rotation and k-th open place are graph roots.

actualCallsites: seated dog beat Xw + ringing flag in Jw
preservedNative: FP64 clock, departure assignment and storage
continuous dog ease curves and look targets
place list construction, Ym table lookup, FP64 slot floor and residue reduction, hash
coverage.exactness: FP64 inputs are encoded as (fround(x), sign(x - fround(x))); FP32 thresholds are exact in-circuit, the single FP32 value nearest a non-FP32 threshold is a counted native boundary path.
coverage.kind: pinned official Handwired compiled weights; not trained
